1.4.3.en:
Adapter requires node.js >= 22 now.
*[@phoeluga]* Dropped Node.js 20 support (EOL) and added Node.js 26 to the test matrix; bumped `engines.node` to `>=22` - #79
*[@phoeluga]* Added `CHANGELOG_OLD.md` to keep the changelog section of this README concise - #62
*[@phoeluga]* Added a Dependabot ignore rule for `@types/node` major version bumps - #64
*[@phoeluga]* Fixed README containing two top-level headings and moved the License section to be the last section
*[@phoeluga]* Added `prettier.config.mjs` re-exporting the shared `@iobroker/eslint-config` prettier config
*[@phoeluga]* Replaced the custom `sleep()`/`setTimeout()` helpers with the lifecycle-managed `this.delay()` from `@iobroker/adapter-core`
*[@phoeluga]* Added a Dependabot cooldown period (`cooldown.default-days: 7`) to reduce supply-chain risk
*[@phoeluga]* Updated outdated devDependencies (`@alcalzone/release-script*` to v5.x, `@iobroker/testing` to 5.2.2)
*[@phoeluga]* Bumped `admin` globalDependency requirement to `>=7.6.20`
*[@phoeluga]* Migrated CI/CD to NPM Trusted Publishing (OIDC) — removed long-lived `NPM_TOKEN`
*[@phoeluga]* Split monolithic `test-and-release.yml` workflow into reusable `test.yml` and `release.yml`
*[@phoeluga]* Added `node:` prefix to all Node.js built-in `require()` calls
*[@phoeluga]* Removed `JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(...))` anti-pattern in REST API client
*[@phoeluga]* Fixed loose equality comparisons (`==` → `===`) throughout codebase
*[@phoeluga]* Removed dead commented-out code and unreachable branches
*[@phoeluga]* Fixed typos in log messages and variable names (`maxItter` → `maxIter`)
*[@phoeluga]* Added optional chaining for safer template interpolation
*[@phoeluga]* Updated copyright year to 2025-2026

* [@phoeluga] * 将自定义 `sleep () `/`setTimeout () `助手替换为来自 @iobroker /adapter-core 的生命周期管理的 `this.delay () `助手
* [@phoeluga] * 添加了 Dependabot 冷却期（`cooldown.default-days：7`）以降低供应链风险
* [@phoeluga] *更新了过时的开发依赖关系（`@alcalzone /release-script* 到 v5.x，` @iobroker /testing` 到 5.2.2） 
* [@phoeluga] * 将 `admin` globalDependency 要求提高到了 `>=7.6.20`
* [@phoeluga] * 将 CI/CD 迁移到 NPM 可信发布 (OIDC) — 删除了长期存在的 `NPM_TOKEN`
* [@phoeluga] * 将单一的 `test-and-release.yml` 工作流程拆分为可重复使用的 `test.yml` 和 `release.yml`
* [@phoeluga] * 为所有 Node.js 内置 `require () `调用添加了 `node:` 前缀
* [@phoeluga] * 删除了 REST API 客户端中的 `json.parse (json.stringify (...)) `反模式
* [@phoeluga] * 修复了整个代码库中的松散相等性比较（`==` → `====）
* [@phoeluga] * 删除了无效的注释代码和无法访问的分支
* [@phoeluga] * 修复了日志消息和变量名中的拼写错误（`maxItter` → `Maxiter`）
* [@phoeluga] * 添加了可选链接以实现更安全的模板插值
* [@phoeluga] * 版权年份更新至 2025-2026
